name: Mount Fuji
description: For a long time this paint was known only as a top-secret project and was used only by the samurai tank forces, until they decided the paint instead should bring peace and quiet to other tankers too. Forget everyday worries and enjoy the living beauty of nature.
interestingFacts: This paint was available in the Shop as part of a special package during the Summer Sale 2018 event.
Paint was added to containers on January 27, 2018.
